inputs.text: [curious] AR… keh… lon. "Arche" means chief, first — [serious] like in "archaeology." And "chelon" is turtle.
[happily] Right — the biggest turtle of all time. She lived seventy-five million years ago, [amazed] in a sea that cut [serious] North America right in half.
[curious] A turtle, but not a dinosaur?
[confident] No, a real giant sea turtle — [warmly] a cousin of today's turtles, just a whole lot bigger.
